_comment: Copy to addons.json (gitignored) and list the addons this box runs. Each name is a directory under addons/. The ATLAS_ADDONS env var overrides this file whenever it is set — ATLAS_ADDONS= (empty) means no addons at all. See docs/ADDONS.md. Example for the WhatsApp bridge: {"enabled": ["whatsapp"]} — but set the WHATSAPP_* variables in .env first (addons/whatsapp/README.md); it is left out of the default list so a fresh copy of this file enables nothing.
